title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Opinion Essay on Time-Limited Reading and Evidence Scope
prompt: Some people believe that when reading under time pressure, readers should focus only on evidence that directly supports the author's main claim, while others argue that a full understanding requires examining the entire scope of evidence, including counterexamples and limitations. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, address the advantages and disadvantages of each approach and explain which you find more convincing. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，明确题目要求讨论的两种观点，并给出你自己的立场。在写作时，请确保：1）讨论两种观点各自的优缺点；2）说明你更支持哪一种方法；3）使用具体例子支持你的论点；4）文章结构清晰，包含引言、主体段落和结论；5）字数不少于250词。建议在40分钟内完成。
